impactTree.mode.description: pr = committed branch vs base; branch = includes uncommitted; working = uncommitted only (agent review); checkpoint = since a recorded SHA

impactTree.baseBranch.description: Base branch. Always resolved to origin/<branch>; a stale local ref silently inflates the diff.

impactTree.fetchBase.description: git fetch the base before resolving it

impactTree.reachDepth.description: How many caller levels the test-reachability walk follows upward from a changed symbol, 1 to 6. A test further up than this is not looked for, so "no test reaches" means no test within this many levels. A value outside the range is replaced with 2 (or 6 when too large) and a warning is shown.

impactTree.analyseOnStartup.description: Analyse as soon as the window opens

impactTree.alwaysDiffCallers.description: Open every caller as a diff against the base, even when the file is identical to base (which shows two panes of the same content). Default: diff only when the file actually differs.

impactTree.concurrency.description: How many symbols to resolve callers for in parallel, from 1 to 32. A value above 32 is capped at 32; a value that is not a number of at least 1 is replaced by the default, 8. Either correction is reported as an analysis warning.

enumDescriptions: File-type glyph from your icon theme (matches the Explorer and other review extensions)
Symbol-kind icon: method / function / constructor (matches Outline)
impactTree.iconMode.description: Which icon change rows use. File rows always show the file-type glyph.

enumDescriptions: A change row shows its verdict glyph only; the verdict in words and the change kinds are in the hover tooltip
A change row also shows the verdict in words and the change kinds (denser, truncates in narrow sidebars)
impactTree.rowDetail.description: Where a change row's verdict and change kinds are shown.

impactTree.prewarm.description: After the window opens, quietly ask the language server to index the changed files so the first analysis is fast. The index is built either way; this just pays for it before you ask.

impactTree.filterInheritedOverReports.description: Drop callers the TypeScript call hierarchy attributes to an override but which actually dispatch on a sibling subclass. Turn off to see the unfiltered call-hierarchy result.

impactTree.tierA.maxFiles.description: Maximum files to fetch for a no-checkout PR preview, 1 to 3000 (the most the GitHub client lists). Each file costs two GitHub API requests (head and base). A value outside the range is replaced with 300 (or 3000 when too large) and a warning is shown.
